## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Privacy and provider boundary

- [ ] No workspace scanning, telemetry, credential export, or silent cross-provider fallback was added.
- [ ] Tests use invented or public sample text and contain no API keys.
- [ ] Any new stored data or network destination is documented explicitly.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` (or explain the environment blocker)
- [ ] `npm run package`
